probe_method: extract the archived DES parameter member; load with native loadDESPackage; apply default FC wizard; enumerate all datasets and wizard properties; resolve vtable slots 6/7
scope: FC PBGA coreVias, upperBuiltUpRegion and lowerBuiltUpRegion in the hash-guarded PACK 2504 build

interpretation.independent_properties: No one-to-one editable activation boolean was found in the full dataset/wizard inventories.
interpretation.isEnabled: All three groups resolve slot 7 to flopackpackages.dll RVA 0x22000 (mov al,1; ret). This is constant availability, not user input.
interpretation.realisation: The FC geometry dispatch checks groupValid through slot 6 before generating groups 4,6,7; validity checks parameter definition rather than an independent activation flag.
interpretation.count_zero: Core zero row/column counts produce no core_vias blocks. A built-up region with zero microvia count still produces its region and an equivalent microvia block; zero is not a region disable flag.
interpretation.limits: Findings describe this binary build and these interfaces; groupValid is not a substitute for complete physical validation.
